This product combines 150mg of Magnesium, 3mg of Manganese, 10μg of Vitamin D, 8.5mg of Zinc, 300mg of Calcium as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (1 tablet): 150mg Magnesium, 3mg Manganese, 10μg Vitamin D, 8.5mg Zinc, 300mg Calcium
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 노바렉스

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Magnesium
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Manganese
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Calcium
    • Needed for the formation of bones and teeth
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Magnesium labelled (150mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (3mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 2000mg), 80~180%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 2000mg), 80~150%
Calcium labelled (300mg / 2000mg), 80~150%

Coliform Negative
